description: Seller/buyer (names, TRN, endpoint, legal registration, emirate), dates, currency, totals, VAT breakdown, line count, payment means, attachments and the detected rule set — without validating. Free. Response: result with verdict (ACCEPTED | ACCEPTED_WITH_WARNINGS | REJECTED), findings[] (id, severity, message, fields, location, fix_hint, source = xsd | schematron | preflight), counts, ruleset version and timings, plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[] and a disclaimer. Documents are validated in memory and never stored or logged.
name: extract_summary
title: Read the key fields of a UBL invoice
